subject: Re: Kickoff: EMCAPSNet - staffing + June compute locked
body:
Anders,

Staffing: Yara 60% (TL, owns the robustness methodology), Gustavo 50% on training runs and the docker path - the repo ships run_local_gpu.sh with NVIDIA docker support, which Giannis has already adapted to our images. Giannis 40% on eval tooling and the checkpoint plumbing (norb_em_checkpoints + smallNORB tfrecords are mirrored internally as of yesterday).

Compute: near-term needs are small - the README's smallNORB training config wants 8 GPUs, fine on titan-a100 best-effort. For M3, compute is sorted: we hold the vulcan-h100 reservation for the week of 2026-06-22 - 512 accelerators for the scale stress-test sweep, with jobs queued to start as soon as the scheduled maintenance wraps on the 24th. It's a short effective window, so Gustavo will have the sweep fully rehearsed on titan beforehand.

One caveat: the release is marked preliminary/under construction, so expect some code archaeology in M1.

Bruno
